scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.emulators: npm run build:backend && firebase emulators:start --only functions,hosting
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:backend: npm run build:backend && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting
